a.lede: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly had an extramarital affair with a direct report, following a separate affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
a.title: Jensen Huang now accused of affair with Nvidia executive who reported to him, alleged cover-up attempt

b.lede: Reuters is withholding the name of the new employee linked to Huang, but says she is an employee of Nvidia.
b.title: Jensen Huang was having a third affair, Reuters reports
